results.description: Angel API returns 200 HTTP OK but payload is []
results.expected: FAIL_CLOSED (Zero writes to Sheets/BQ, alarm logged)

results.description: 219 quotes returned, but 1 token has null/empty exchFeedTime
results.expected: FAIL_CLOSED (Reject partial exchange time as unverified)
results.behavior: Detected 1 unverified feed time; halted before snapshot generation.

results.description: Timestamp format mismatch between Asia/Kolkata and UTC
results.behavior: Correctly converted and verified zero temporal drift across timezones.
Duplicate token detected; rejected universe corruption.

results.description: Market open, but feed timestamp belongs to previous date (age > 18 hours)
results.expected: FAIL_CLOSED (Detect stale feed, mark STALE, do not publish)
results.behavior: Age exceeded 180s SLA; marked STALE and aborted publication.

results.description: Connection dropped after fetching 100 of 219 symbols
results.expected: FAIL_CLOSED (No destructive overwrite of production with partial 100 symbols)
results.behavior: Refused destructive write of partial universe; preserved prior snapshot.

results.description: Concurrent write attempts racing on Google Sheets cell ranges
results.expected: IDEMPOTENT_ATOMIC_GRID (Fixed rectangular write_grid with single-writer lease)
results.behavior: Enforced single-writer lease + bounded write_grid to eliminate cell race.

results.description: BigQuery streaming buffer locks table from concurrent DDL/DML
results.expected: BATCH_LOAD_CONFIG (Use LoadJob with WRITE_TRUNCATE and durable replay)
results.behavior: LoadJob configured with atomic WRITE_TRUNCATE; bypasses streaming lock.

results.description: Git push fails due to remote lock or network drop after 3 retries
results.expected: ATOMIC_ROLLBACK (Staged changes reverted, local working tree remains clean)
results.behavior: Atomic snapshots tool rolled back staged files to base commit; zero corruption.

results.description: OS raises ENOSPC (No space left on device) during snapshot save
results.expected: FAIL_CLOSED_WITH_MEMORY_FALLBACK (Catch ENOSPC, log memory incident, exit 1)
results.behavior: Cleanly trapped ENOSPC without unhandled crash; preserved memory state.

results.description: Market loop streaming 5,000 continuous quotes into memory buffer
results.expected: BOUNDED_MEMORY (Sliding circular buffer caps memory at fixed limit)
results.behavior: Buffer capped at 1,000 items; zero unbounded heap expansion.
